purpose: SP3 E gain split: one bounded causal split on the input-response relation (f-I slope). Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-07-h01-e-gain-split.md. Registered, not run.
cache_note: The h01-e-split worktree is a sparse checkout without .cache; the waveforms (sweep-43/50/53/56.npz, data only, gitignored) live in the sibling h01-braincell cache. Change cache_dir to .cache/human-pyramidal-l2 when the manifest runs from a root that holds the cache.
holdout: Sweep 54 (330 pA) is sealed (h01_l2_sweep_export.SEALED, prediction file h01-prediction-e3.json) and is not an input of any stage. Sweep 56 is calibration, not a holdout: its repeats feed the AHP spread and its count metadata is visible.
evaluation: One parameter set at all four inputs; one evaluation = four serial runs in one container.

0.title: Stage 0: frozen B3 at sweeps 43 and 56 (50 and 53 rerun under the new stems)
0.prediction: Sweep-43 onset rows (1019-1120 ms) and late-return rows (1520-2120 ms) within 1 mV of the human (B3's Stage B levers did not touch F5). Sweep-56 count 1 (repeat band over 56/59/60/61/62 is exact) and first-spike latency within the repeat limit (range x 1.47). Sweep 50 and 53 reproduce b3-all-inputs-usable.md (8 and 10 spikes) within solver noise. Axon-first initiation at every active input.
0.rejection: Sweep 43 fails the 1 mV row: B3's Stage B levers broke F5; every Stage G arm is judged on the change of its sweep-43 rows relative to g0-b3, not on an absolute pass. A different 250 or 310 pA count than B3 means the image or input differs and the campaign stops.
0.unchanged: All B3 flags (b3-sk035-ca-decay.candidate.json, sha256 e4825c83bdc7980a469b5501b2a54c68e680f1cb52a2055d36bcf4fc7b70e564): calcium_decay_factor 1.0, distribute_ih, ih_density_factor 75, insert_density NaTs:axon:3.814, kv3_closing_factor 0.9, leak_reversal_shift_mv -4, regional_density SK:soma:0.35, sodium_density_factor 0.9, sodium_opening_factor 2.0, sodium_recovery_factor 1.0; nseg factor 9; CVode 1e-10; stop 2100 ms; recorded command plus recorded bias; Allen 541563728 geometry; library kv3-closing-source; image braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2.

G.title: Stage G: one steady inter-spike current halved (Ih) or the linear leak raised (1.5x), every arm at sweeps 43/50/53/56
G.prediction: g1-ih-half (ih_density_factor 37.5 from 75): 250 pA count 5-7 with late cycles >= 200 ms; 310 pA count 9-10 with rate within 1.5 Hz of 10.0 Hz; pre-pulse baseline -1 to -3 mV from B3; sweep-43 late return moves <= 1 mV; 200 pA count 1. g2-leak-150 (leak_factor 1.5, reversal unchanged): both counts fall, 250 pA proportionally more (rheobase shifts right): 250 count <= 6, 310 count >= 8; 200 pA count 0-1.
G.rejection: g1-ih-half: 310 count < 9, or 250 count still >= 8. g2-leak-150: 250 and 310 fall by the same spike count (pure shift, no rotation). Either arm losing axon-first initiation or moving the sweep-43 return by more than 1 mV is a rejection of that arm.
G.unchanged: As Stage 0 except the one named flag per arm.

G3.title: Stage G3: reserve dose of the better arm (candidate appended after stage-g-decision.json names the dose)
G3.prediction: Dose rule fixed before the run: the arm with the larger |delta(250 count)| / |delta(310 rate)| per unit factor change, factor interpolated linearly to land 250 count 5 while the 310 rate change stays within 1.5 Hz; the numerical dose is written into stage-g-decision.json before the candidate g3-reserve is appended. Predicted: 250 count 5 +/- 1, 310 rate within 1.5 Hz, sweep 43 within 1 mV, 200 count 1, axon-first.
G3.rejection: As the chosen arm. If neither G1 nor G2 rotated the curve (both rejected), G3 is not run and the campaign reports FAIL at 3 of 4.
G3.unchanged: As Stage 0 except the dosed flag.

pass_rule: One profile with rate and adaptation passing at 250/310 pA (and 350 from the retained B3 sweep-55 trace for g0-b3; 200 pA where resolvable), no width cycle newly failing relative to b3-all-inputs-usable.md, sweep-43 rows within 1 mV, axon-first at every active input.
fail_rule: No arm meets the pass rule by the cap: FAIL, and the reassessment is a gain set outside the fit's passive family (human slow Na inactivation or Kv7/M kinetics absent from the Allen genome, or a second human L2/3 donor with a recorded f-I curve).
cost_anchor: 649-665 s per 250/310 pA run (measured, h01-e-continuation-result.md). Sweep 43 and sweep 56 unmeasured. One evaluation exceeds 15 min at the anchor alone, so each evaluation needs a measured estimate and approval before it opens; Stage 0 reports the 43 and 56 durations before Stage G.
budget_note: Stage 0: 1. Stage G: 2 = 3. Stage G3: 1 = 4. Nothing in reserve beyond G3.
